_field_status_legend.confirmed: Stated by the real printer. Authoritative.
_field_status_legend.assumed: Conventional DTF working baseline adopted for the calibration experiment ONLY. NOT a printer-confirmed requirement. Must be confirmed or disproved by the Gate 1a physical transfer.
_field_status_legend.unknown: Not supplied and not assumed. Checks depending on this field report PENDING, never PASS or FAIL. Tolerances are never invented (D-11).

required_dpi.source: measured on the Gate 1a export-check transfer, 2026-08-18: a file built at 300 DPI printed at its exact stated physical size on both axes

colour_space.source: conventional DTF working baseline (RIP converts to CMYK+white)
colour_space.confirm_via: Not established by the Gate 1a export check - that artefact carried no colour. Still a working assumption.

rip_handles_mirroring.source: conventional DTF working baseline — artwork supplied unmirrored
rip_handles_mirroring.confirm_via: Not yet confirmed - the ORIENT marker was not read back. Still a working assumption.

min_reliable_stroke_mm.confirm_via: Calibration stroke ladder — measure the finest stroke that survives transfer.

max_partial_alpha_ratio.confirm_via: Calibration alpha step wedge and hard-edge/fade pair — measure where the white underbase turns to haze.

white_underbase_behaviour.confirm_via: Calibration white-density test and alpha step wedge.

min_negative_space_mm.confirm_via: Calibration negative-space/counter test — measure the smallest gap that does not fill in.

printer_resizes_files.source: measured on the Gate 1a export-check transfer, 2026-08-18: both the 100 mm horizontal and 100 mm vertical references measured 100 mm
